 FC Sevilla vs. Deportivo Alaves: kick-off time
 LaLiga - Game Week 12 6 Nov 2026 - 14:00 Estadio R. Sanchez Pizjuan At the Estadio Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán in Sevilla, FC Sevilla host Deportivo Alavés in LaLiga. The sides arrive in different positions after contrasting results in recent weeks.
 Sixth in the table, Sevilla have struggled for consistency. Their recent heavy 1:3 defeat to Getafe dampened the mood after wins over Osasuna and Sporting Hortaleza had briefly raised hopes.
 Coach Luis Garcia’s side have also looked vulnerable defensively. A 4:1 defeat to Real Madrid and a 3:3 draw with Levante show how matches can slip away when Sevilla's concentration drops.
 For Alavés, the trip to Sevilla comes during a difficult spell. They sit 11th, and a 1:6 defeat to FC Barcelona in their last match dealt Quique Sanchez Flores’s side another blow. They have not won any of their last five LaLiga matches.
 A goalless draw with Athletic Bilbao and a 1:1 draw with Málaga show that Alavés can keep matches close. Sevilla cannot afford to underestimate the Basque side.
 You can find the live broadcast information below.
 Topics of the week: what has been happening at FC Sevilla and Deportivo Alaves?
 Across their last five competitive matches, Sevilla have recorded two wins, one draw and two defeats. Most recently, they lost 1:3 to Getafe in LaLiga. Before that came a 4:1 defeat to Real Madrid, while a 2:0 win over Osasuna and a cup win against Sporting Hortaleza provided brighter moments. Sevilla scored nine goals and conceded twelve in those five matches.
 Alavés have taken no wins, two draws and three defeats from their last five LaLiga matches. Their most recent game ended in a 1:6 defeat to FC Barcelona, following a 1:1 draw with Málaga and a 1:2 defeat to Celta Vigo. They scored four goals and conceded eleven during that period.
